name: print-social-slate-visual-hierarchy-primary-secondary-tertiary-post
title: Visual Hierarchy Primary Secondary Tertiary
whatItIs: A slate-blue slide, Rule 4 Visual Hierarchy, with a light heading and three words, Primary, Secondary and Tertiary, each smaller and paired with a solid, half-tone and outlined dot.
whatItMeans: The slide is its own demonstration: the layout itself shows what hierarchy looks like through size and fill.
techniques: Demonstrate the concept in the layout itself
Three sizes stepping down for three importance levels
Filled, half, empty dots as an importance scale
Condensed caps label above a light sentence
Two-colour palette of slate and cream

vocabulary.definition: Ordering elements by importance using size, weight and contrast.
A design that illustrates its own message.
Marks whose fill level signals priority.
